name: Ricardo Alonso
bio:
Ricardo's motorsport journey began in karting, where he honed his race strategy skills from a young age, often acting as the de facto race engineer for his own team. He transitioned to Formula Ford in Spain before pursuing a degree in mechanical engineering, recognizing the importance of technical expertise. After graduating, Ricardo worked as a data analyst for a smaller GT team, rapidly progressing to become their lead strategist and later, sporting director.

Ricardo is known for his meticulous approach to race weekend preparation and his ability to adapt strategies on the fly based on real-time data analysis. He emphasizes clear communication between the engineering team, drivers, and pit crew, believing that a collaborative environment is essential for success. His distinctive trait is his focus on extracting marginal gains through innovative data-driven insights, always seeking an edge over the competition. He's keen to bring his data driven style to Dick Johnson Racing.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Ricardo has a serious demeanor, often seen with a focused expression, and a neatly dressed appearance.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific brand of Spanish coffee before every race.
